description: This file defines the MssqlManager class, an implementation of a database manager for Microsoft SQL Server, used within the SuiteCRM project. It handles connection setup, query execution, schema modification, and other database operations specific to MSSQL.

classes.name: MssqlManager
classes.description: A class that manages MSSQL database interactions, including connection handling, query execution, schema modifications, and full-text search setup, tailored for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the MSSQL database using provided or default configuration options.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Retrieves the current SQL Server version.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query on the connected MSSQL database.

methods.name: limitQuery
methods.description: Executes a query with limit and offset, adjusting for MSSQL syntax.

methods.name: fetchRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row from a query result as an associative array.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe usage in SQL queries.

methods.name: quoteIdentifier
methods.description: Escapes an identifier (e.g., table or column name).

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database.

methods.name: tablesLike
methods.description: Returns tables matching a pattern.

methods.name: getTablesArray
methods.description: Retrieves an array of all table names.

methods.name: full_text_indexing_setup
methods.description: Sets up full-text indexing on specified tables, used during installation.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a value to a specific SQL Server data type or format.

methods.name: fromConvert
methods.description: Converts data from SQL Server format to application format.

methods.name: createTableSQLParams
methods.description: Generates the SQL to create a table with specified fields and indices.

methods.name: isTextType
methods.description: Determines if a data type is a text type.

methods.name: emptyValue
methods.description: Returns the appropriate empty value for a specific data type.

methods.name: renameColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to rename a column.

methods.name: alterSQLRep
methods.description: Produces SQL for altering a column in a table.

methods.name: changeColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to change a column's data type or properties.

methods.name: setAutoIncrement
methods.description: Returns SQL syntax for setting an auto-increment property.

methods.name: setAutoIncrementStart
methods.description: Sets the starting value for an auto-increment column.

methods.name: getAutoIncrement
methods.description: Retrieves the current auto-increment value for a table.

methods.name: get_indices
methods.description: Retrieves indices for a specified table.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Retrieves column definitions for a table.

methods.name: full_text_indexing_installed
methods.description: Checks if full-text indexing is installed.

methods.name: full_text_indexing_enabled
methods.description: Checks if full-text indexing is enabled on the database.

methods.name: create_default_full_text_catalog
methods.description: Creates a default full-text catalog for indexing.

methods.name: getFieldDefaultConstraintName
methods.description: Retrieves the default constraint name for a field.

methods.name: fetchByAssoc
methods.description: Fetches a row as an associative array (implied from context in code).

methods.name: save_audit_records
methods.description: Saves changes to module’s audit table, with special handling for date type.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the database, freeing resources.

methods.name: freeDbResult
methods.description: Frees the database result resource.

methods.name: lastDbError
methods.description: Retrieves the last database error message, filtering out non-critical messages.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the database, such as version.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates an SQL query by checking its execution plan.

methods.name: _appendN
methods.description: Adds 'N' prefix to SQL string literals to denote nvarchar type, handling complex string parsing.

methods.name: quoteTerm
methods.description: Quotes a search term for full-text search with special handling for wildcards.

methods.name: getFulltextQuery
methods.description: Generates a full-text search query string based on inclusion and exclusion terms.

methods.name: dbExists
methods.description: Checks if a database exists.

methods.name: selectDb
methods.description: Selects a database for subsequent operations.

methods.name: userExists
methods.description: Checks if a database user exists.

methods.name: createDbUser
methods.description: Creates a new database login and user, and assigns roles.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database.

methods.name: dropDatabase
methods.description: Drops an existing database.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the MSSQL PHP extension/functionality is available.

methods.name: isDatabaseNameValid
methods.description: Validates a database name against allowed character rules.

methods.name: installConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration labels and required fields for database setup.

methods.name: getFromDummyTable
methods.description: Provides a database-specific FROM clause (empty string for MSSQL).

methods.name: getGuidSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL expression for generating a GUID/UUID.

methods.name: removeIndexLimit
methods.description: Removes index size limits from field definitions.
